name: @w6w-apps/strapi
description: Read, create, update and delete entries on any Strapi content type, and browse the media library.

w6w.longDescription:
Strapi reads, creates, updates and deletes entries on any Strapi content type and browses the media library, working against any self-hosted or cloud Strapi instance rather than one fixed host. Because every Strapi install lives at its own address, the instance's own URL is set once when the connection is created, and every action builds its request from that.

The app is entirely collection-agnostic: every entry action names the content type to work against, so one connection reaches every collection a given Strapi project defines rather than a fixed handful. Entries can be listed with filters, sorting and pagination, read individually, created, updated and deleted, and Strapi's own entry-id conventions are passed through unchanged whether the instance uses the older numeric ids or the newer document-id form.

Authentication uses Strapi's own long-lived API tokens — scoped to read-only, full access, or custom permissions — rather than the separate end-user login flow, since a workflow credential should belong to the integration, not to a human account. Content-type schema editing is left entirely to Strapi's own admin panel; this app works only with the data those content types hold.
